description:
Base blueprint for Smart Meter Insights tenants (Epic AB#4059,
AB#5211/AB#5213/AB#5245/AB#5246).

Topology: the app-host (management) tenant runs the single shared Application
workload; one child tenant per consulting firm (energy-community AB#3683
pattern). This blueprint is installed on BOTH: the app host needs the
Application + the client mirror source, the consulting-firm tenants need the
model, archives, roles and the HTTP API. End customers are runtime entities
(SmartMeterInsights/Customer) inside the firm tenant — never tenants.

Installs:
- The SmartMeterInsights CK model (Customer, ImportSession, ShareLink,
  DetectionResult, Recommendation on top of Basic/Basic.Energy; time series
  reuse Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement).
- Identity: roles InsightsConsultant/InsightsAdmin, groups Consultants/Admins,
  and the PKCE clients smart-meter-insights-app + smart-meter-insights-app-debug
  (both AutoProvisionInChildTenants, so every consulting-firm child tenant
  gets a mirror and sign-in against a child never fails with
  Invalid redirect_uri).
- The Basic/Tree root "Anlagen" (510…100) — the parent anchor for every
  OperatingFacility the app creates (the CK association System/ParentChild on
  OperatingFacility is mandatory; SMI has no geography seed, unlike
  energy-community's Basic/City nodes).
- Stream-data archives for Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement: raw 15-min
  TimeRangeArchive (energy-measurements, 510…a01) with the cascaded rollup
  ladder raw -> hourly -> daily -> monthly (calendar-aligned Europe/Vienna;
  SUM amountvalue_sum + MAX dataquality_max + count chain). All archives ship
  Disabled (Archive.Status = 2) — activate bottom-up via
  octo-cli -c ActivateArchive after EnableStreamData (CrateDB reachable).
- The smart-meter-insights DataFlow (510…001) with two HTTP pipelines on the
  default Mesh Adapter 670…002:
    POST /smi/import (smi-import-readings, role InsightsConsultant) —
      pre-normalized 15-min readings -> EnergyMeasurement anchor upsert per
      (MeteringPoint, ObisCode) + archive save + ImportSession entity.
    POST /smi/share (smi-share-read, anonymous — THE one deliberate
      exception) — validates a ShareLink token, counts the access and returns
      the scoped dashboard payload; with ShowDevices/ShowRecommendations set
      it additionally carries the current DetectionResults / the PUBLISHED
      Recommendations (AB#5245).
- The System.Communication/Application workload (510…200, chart
  smart-meter-insights from the dev Helm repository 670…003, hostname
  energy-insights.{{domain.DEFAULT}}). Hostname/Values/ChartVersion/
  IngressEnabled are isRuntimeState (System.Communication >= 3.28), so seed
  values apply on fresh installs only.

DELIBERATELY NOT SEEDED: the Pool (670…001), the Mesh Adapter (670…002) and
the Helm repositories (670…003/005) belong to the service-managed
System.Communication blueprint and reappear on every EnableCommunication.

Prerequisites:
- Communication enabled on the tenant (default Pool/Adapter/Helm repo exist).
- Stream data enabled (octo-cli -c EnableStreamData; CrateDB reachable)
  BEFORE activating the archives.

Post-install:
1. Activate the archives bottom-up:
   octo-cli -c ActivateArchive 510000000000000000000a01 (raw), then …a02
   (hourly), …a03 (daily), …a04 (monthly).
2. Deploy the HTTP API:
   octo-cli -c DeployDataFlow --identifier 510000000000000000000001
3. On the app-host tenant only: deploy the workload
   octo-cli -c DeployWorkload -id 510000000000000000000200

The seed is split with seedDataPaths (one file per topic); all files are
merged into ONE runtime model before the import runs, so the order is
presentation only and associations may cross files. Requires an engine that
knows seedDataPaths (AB#4758).
